findings.title: rubric.json categories diverge from findings in index.json
findings.summary: 24 of 26 findings in .audits/index.json use categories (stale-content, correctness, yaml, inconsistency) not defined in rubric.json, making the rubric the wrong source of truth for category validation.
findings.fix_summary: Added stale-content, correctness, yaml, and inconsistency category definitions to rubric.json with canonical mappings.

findings.title: index.json references 20260717T040000Z.json which does not exist on disk
findings.summary: nightly_audits array in index.json lists 20260717T040000Z.json but that file is absent from .audits/, causing any tooling that iterates nightly_audits to fail with a missing-file error.
findings.fix_summary: Removed 20260717T040000Z.json from nightly_audits array in index.json.

findings.title: 17 findings in index.json have string closing_pr values instead of integers
findings.summary: The closed.json schema and self-heal-pipeline.md spec define closing_pr as an integer (GitHub PR number or sentinel 0). 17 findings in index.json store branch-name strings like 'audit/nightly-2026-07-13', violating the schema contract.
findings.fix_summary: Changed all 17 string closing_pr values to integer 0 (no-PR-sentinel per spec) in index.json.

findings.title: Two findings missing fingerprint and using non-canonical ID format
findings.summary: Findings AUDIT-audit-elevation-proposer-date-2026-07-13 and AUDIT-audit-elevation-ifleet-adrs-date-2026-07-13 use a date-embedded ID format inconsistent with the AUDIT-<repo>-<hash8> convention, and lack fingerprint fields required by the schema.
findings.fix_summary: Renamed both findings to AUDIT-<repo>-<hash8> format and added computed SHA-256 fingerprints.

findings.title: Phase 6 gate condition references Phase 3 soak which has been superseded by Phase 4 decision
findings.summary: README.md Phase 6 row states 'gated on Phase 3 soak' but Phase 3 soak criteria are unmet and the actual blocker is the pending Phase 4 decision (62 days overdue). Stale gate condition could mislead readers about what must happen before Phase 6 can proceed.
findings.fix_summary: Updated Phase 6 gate condition to reference Phase 4 decision with accurate overdue count.

findings.title: self-heal-pipeline.md cites wrong AUDIT ID for version→schema_version rename
findings.summary: Line 65 of self-heal-pipeline.md cites AUDIT-ae-d9e0f1a2 as evidence for the schema_version field rename, but that ID maps to a stale-date finding opened 2026-07-28, not a field-rename finding. The citation is factually wrong and would mislead audit-fix tooling following the backlink.
findings.fix_summary: Removed incorrect AUDIT ID citation; replaced with plain prose ('renamed in the 2026-05-24 nightly scan').

findings.title: Phase 3 row missing note about Codex-absent mode blocking unmet criteria
findings.summary: README.md Phase 3 row does not document that two of the three Phase 3 criteria (Codex multi-model + warm-standby) remain unmet because Codex is not active in Codex-absent mode. Without this note, readers cannot assess whether Phase 3 is 'blocked' or 'skipped by design'.
findings.fix_summary: Added parenthetical note to Phase 3 row explaining Codex-absent mode and unmet criteria.

findings.title: Day counts stale across 5 files (59→62 days overdue, 73→76 days elapsed)
findings.summary: README.md, plan.md, docs/proposer-spec.md, docs/quota-pacing-design.md, and docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md all reference '59 days overdue as of 2026-08-02' or '73 days elapsed as of 2026-08-02' — both stale as of today 2026-08-05.
findings.fix_summary: Updated all occurrences to '62 days overdue as of 2026-08-05' and '76 days elapsed as of 2026-08-05'.

findings.title: quota-pacing-design.md §1 and §7 use present-tense 'Tonight' for a completed event
findings.summary: quota-pacing-design.md §1 says 'Tonight's elevation push runs' and §7 says 'Tonight gets us to step 1.' — both refer to the 2026-05-20 elevation push which completed over 76 days ago. Present tense is misleading.
findings.fix_summary: Changed §1 and §7 to past tense referencing the 2026-05-21 elevation push by date.

findings.title: lane-scheduler-spec.md §5 says '(not built tonight)' for a shipped feature
findings.summary: lane-scheduler-spec.md §5 Future Work says '(not built tonight)' referring to the Phase 4+ features. The lane-scheduler MVP shipped during the 2026-05-21 elevation push, making 'tonight' a stale reference.

findings.title: ifleet-integration-adrs.md ADR-0002 Decision self-references ADR-0002
findings.summary: The Decision field for ADR-0002 in ifleet-integration-adrs.md says 'matches the Docker-unreachable fallback in ADR-0002' — the ADR references itself. Should describe the actual decision pattern.
findings.fix_summary: Changed self-reference to describe the actual pattern: 'fail-open to available provider when Codex is unreachable'.

findings.title: 12 findings in index.json missing file_globs and parallel_safe fields
findings.summary: 12 findings (IDs: 29f1e5a0, 4b13a7c2, 5c24b8d3, 6d35c9e4, c3f5e9a4, d4a6f0b5, e5b7a1c6, f6c8b2d7, 6d35cf24, 740e2a40, 6ddd8cba, d2299e84) are missing file_globs and parallel_safe fields required by the index.json schema.
findings.fix_summary: Added file_globs and parallel_safe fields to all 12 affected findings.

findings.title: Mixed ISO date formats in index.json (T000000Z vs T050000Z suffix convention)
findings.summary: index.json uses inconsistent date suffix conventions: some scan IDs end in T000000Z and some in T050000Z. The nightly_audits array mixes these formats making it unclear which is canonical.
findings.fix_summary: Added 20260805T050000Z.json to nightly_audits following the T050000Z convention used by the current run; noted in last_updated.
